mentions.name: Hobby x86 kernel (80486 target)
mentions.description: This hobby x86 kernel targets vintage hardware (an 80486DX2-66 PC with 32MB of RAM). It supports basic virtual memory with kmalloc()/kfree(), task switching, user mode, and a few syscalls, and includes a floppy driver that can semi-reliably detect and read data off floppy disks. A userspace ext2 parser written for the project is planned to be brought into the kernel to provide filesystem support.
